reasoning: The working banks showed +0.0187 and +0.0257 with intervals excluding zero. The unseen bank shows +0.0036 with an interval that includes zero, so on scenarios the candidate was never screened against it is statistically indistinguishable from production. The directional gains persist - center_mobility +27, pursuit +16 - but adversarial_corner regresses -38, the largest of any bank, and offsets them almost entirely.
generalisation_finding: The holdout carries more baseline captures on adversarial_corner (117) than development (92) or validation (101). The candidate's apparent edge on the working banks was therefore partly a function of how much weight those banks gave the one family it regresses on. That is precisely what an unseen bank exists to expose.
post_holdout_tuning: none - the candidate was frozen by module digest before the bank was consumed, and is not being retuned
consequence: Production CompetitiveStrategy remains the Police strategy. A future cycle needs a new sealed version; v3 is now spent and can never be blind again.
